Question 7
?

Which of the following gives the line integral of the function f(x,y)=xe1−y2 along the quarter-circle x2+y2=36, traversed from the point (6,0) to the point (0,6) in the first quadrant?

a
36∫π/2πcos⁡te1−36sin2⁡tdt
b
6∫π/2πcos⁡te1−36sin2⁡tdt
c
36∫0π/2cos⁡te1−sin2⁡tdt
d
6∫0π/2cos⁡te1−6sin2⁡tdt
e
36∫0π/2cos⁡te1−36sin2⁡tdt
